finding: Once legacy LAYER export succeeded, a generated open R12 POLYLINE exposed VERTEX and SEQEND records with default layer and linetype instead of the parent's PLINE_LAYER and BYBLOCK values. LibreCAD's bundled writer already carries the parent's presentation.
change: For system-codec DXF export, copy only layer, linetype and color from the generated parent to newly synthesized vertices; provide an R12 SEQEND with the same presentation. Do not copy source identities, application data or XDATA. The writer retains its compound-record handle allocation and transaction.

validation.systemFocused: PASS: 1874 assertions in 26 tagged cases. The R12 checks include child layer/linetype, distinct parent/vertex/footer handles and open/closed vertex counts.
validation.bundledFocused: PASS: 1513 assertions in 19 matching tagged cases.

limits: The SEQEND presentation change is limited to R12; modern source-retained child metadata and native CAD qualification are separate.
Independent reopened semantics and failure/retry for other polyline profiles remain open.
